explication: Gemini Watermark Tool is an offline image watermark removal and addition application, exposed through CLI automation and a desktop GUI. The principal workflow loads images, detects and profiles a watermark, reconstructs pixels with reverse alpha blending, optionally cleans residual artifacts, and saves or previews the result; batch processing extends that workflow to directories. The graph includes the documented FDnCNN cleanup and rendering choices. Video removal and MCP/agent workflows are mentioned in the README but are not implemented in the shown source tree, so they are not represented as runtime subsystems.
